Standard: Immediate action striping on NVIS compatible panels should be IAW MIL-DTL- 7788, Immediate Action Striping-NVIS Compatible paragraph. Immediate action striping on non-NVIS compatible panels should be IAW MIL-DTL-7788, Immediate Action Striping-Non- NVIS Compatible paragraph. Emergency controls that are not on a panel are coded with orange-yellow and black immediate action striping IAW with MIL-STD-1472, Immediate Action Controls paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review drawings to verify that emergency controls are properly marked.
(2) Examine the air vehicle and verify that emergency controls are properly marked.
